name: Previous Softwarecatalogus export
description: How stackiq reads an organisation's export from the previous Softwarecatalogus (xlsx): one sheet with one row per application the organisation uses, keyed on the previous catalogue's id of that usage. Each row normalises to a supplier, an application (module), a version and the usage itself. Reference components and connections are not read. Columns that neither this profile nor a pack names are never read.
